commands.when: Live mode on Nebius: run Night School (night), advance the release gate (tick), reload adapters after an endpoint restart (reload), seal savings receipts (seal), apply retention now (purge) or export an adapter with its licenses (export).
commands.help:
Live-mode Night School on Nebius: train on a Serverless Job, hot-load the adapter into vLLM, evaluate.

    python -m ratchet.live night        # run one night against the live ledger
    python -m ratchet.live tick         # advance the release gate (run every few minutes via cron)
    python -m ratchet.live reload       # re-load live/canary/shadow adapters after an endpoint restart (the gateway
                                        # also does this by itself when vLLM answers 404 for an adapter: AdapterReloader)
    python -m ratchet.live purge [--client NAME] [--older-than-days N] [--dry-run]
                                        # apply the retention windows now (FR-13.4); the gateway does it hourly
    python -m ratchet.live export --version N --out DIR
                                        # an adapter with its licenses: the adapter folder (when synced locally), its
                                        # BOM and NOTICE.md in DIR; prints the BOM's sha256 (NFR-9)
    python -m ratchet.live seal         # seal the savings receipts of every day that has ended (run hourly via cron:
                                        # a ledger day starts at the first request's time of day, not 00:00 UTC; the
                                        # gateway also seals when a receipt is asked for)

Environment (in addition to ratchet.config):
    RATCHET_DATA_DIR      local folder synced to the bucket mounted in jobs/endpoints (default ./data)
    RATCHET_SYNC_CMD      command that uploads RATCHET_DATA_DIR to the bucket, e.g.
                          "aws s3 sync ./data s3://my-bucket/ratchet --endpoint-url https://storage.eu-north1.nebius.cloud"
                          (run before training, and again after a night that trained, to upload the adapter's BOM
                          into its folder; never with --delete, which would remove the weights the job wrote there)
    RATCHET_TRAIN_CMD     command that runs the training job and waits for it; {version} and {data}
                          are substituted, e.g. "bash deploy/train_job.sh {version}"
    RATCHET_ADAPTER_ROOT  where the endpoint sees adapters (default /data/adapters)

After a night that trained, the adapter's BOM and NOTICE.md go to RATCHET_DATA_DIR/adapters/<name>/ (ratchet_bom.json,
NOTICE.md) and RATCHET_SYNC_CMD runs again, so the bucket's adapter folder holds the weights and their licenses together.

commands.when: Hand an adapter to someone else with its bill of materials and NOTICE.md.
commands.help:
usage: python -m ratchet.live export [-h] --version VERSION --out OUT

Copy an adapter with its licenses into a folder: the adapter files (when
RATCHET_DATA_DIR/adapters/<name> holds them), its bill of materials (ratchet_bom.json) and
NOTICE.md; prints the BOM's sha256.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --version VERSION  the version id (as in /ratchet/versions/{id}/bom)
  --out OUT          the folder to write; it must not exist yet or be empty

commands.when: Apply the retention windows now instead of waiting for the gateway's hourly run.
commands.help:
usage: python -m ratchet.live purge [-h] [--client CLIENT] [--older-than-days OLDER_THAN_DAYS]
                                    [--dry-run]

Apply the retention windows now (FR-13.4): purge the text of examples not seen for
RATCHET_EXAMPLE_RETENTION_DAYS and fold request rows older than RATCHET_REQUEST_RETENTION_DAYS
into daily sums.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --client CLIENT       only this API client's examples and request rows
  --older-than-days OLDER_THAN_DAYS
                        this window, in whole days, for both examples and requests (instead of the
                        settings)
  --dry-run             count what would go and change nothing

commands.when: Run the whole loop offline with mock models (simulation): days of traffic, nights of training, releases and rollbacks.
commands.help:
usage: python -m sim.simulate [-h] [--days DAYS] [--requests REQUESTS] [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                   [--audit-rate AUDIT_RATE] [--min-shadow MIN_SHADOW] [--min-audits MIN_AUDITS]
                   [--min-new MIN_NEW] [--drift-day DRIFT_DAY]
                   [--bad-deploy-version BAD_DEPLOY_VERSION]
                   [--workload {tickets,research,mixed,schema,tools}] [--seed SEED]
                   [--release {wilson,sequential}] [--promote-evidence]
                   [--canary-audit-rate CANARY_AUDIT_RATE] [--calibration {point,ltt}]
                   [--cert-target CERT_TARGET] [--cert-delta CERT_DELTA] [--paired-gate]
                   [--min-certified MIN_CERTIFIED] [--compare-release] [--receipts]
                   [--teacher-reasoning-mean TEACHER_REASONING_MEAN]
                   [--teacher-reasoning-cv TEACHER_REASONING_CV] [--out OUT] [--db DB]

Ratchet offline simulation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --days DAYS
  --requests REQUESTS   requests per day
  --threshold THRESHOLD
  --audit-rate AUDIT_RATE
  --min-shadow MIN_SHADOW
  --min-audits MIN_AUDITS
  --min-new MIN_NEW
  --drift-day DRIFT_DAY
                        day a new product launches (0 = never)
  --bad-deploy-version BAD_DEPLOY_VERSION
                        fault injection: this student version is pushed corrupted to production
  --workload {tickets,research,mixed,schema,tools}
                        tickets, Scout research calls, both (mixed), structured outputs (schema)
                        or tool requests (tools)
  --seed SEED
  --release {wilson,sequential}
                        canary rule: the Wilson bound per stage, or the anytime-valid e-process
                        (ADR 0025)
  --promote-evidence    with --release sequential: promote a canary stage only on an e-value that
                        precision is above the floor
  --canary-audit-rate CANARY_AUDIT_RATE
                        the canary's own audit rate, more than 0 and at most 1 (default: --audit-
                        rate)
  --calibration {point,ltt}
                        threshold rule: the point rule at 97%, or Learn-then-Test over a fixed
                        grid (ADR 0026)
  --cert-target CERT_TARGET
                        the precision a certificate must show
  --cert-delta CERT_DELTA
                        a certificate's error rate
  --paired-gate         compare each candidate with the live version row by row on the same golden
                        rows (exact McNemar tests)
  --min-certified MIN_CERTIFIED
                        reject a candidate whose certified lower bound is below this (0 = off)
  --compare-release     run twice with the same seed, once per --release rule, and compare the
                        rolled-back versions
  --receipts            seal each day's savings receipt and print it next to the true all-teacher
                        cost (ADR 0029)
  --teacher-reasoning-mean TEACHER_REASONING_MEAN
                        the mock teacher bills this many reasoning tokens on average instead of
                        exactly 300 (e.g. 420)
  --teacher-reasoning-cv TEACHER_REASONING_CV
                        with --teacher-reasoning-mean: the spread (coefficient of variation,
                        default 0.3)
  --out OUT
  --db DB               write the run's ledger to this SQLite file (it must not exist yet), e.g.
                        for python -m ratchet.replay

commands.when: Before live mode: check the model IDs, logprobs and JSON mode on Token Factory with a real key (costs a few cents).
commands.help:
Day-1 check: confirm the Token Factory pieces Ratchet depends on actually work.

    NEBIUS_API_KEY=... python scripts/day1_check.py

Checks: the model IDs exist, the teacher answers, logprobs come back, JSON mode works, the
teacher accepts the generation parameters the gateway sends it (`max_tokens` at
RATCHET_TEACHER_MAX_TOKENS, `stop`, `seed`, `temperature`, `response_format`; ADR 0017), and
whether it takes `response_format` json_schema (strict) with an answer that matches the schema
(ADR 0042). A teacher that refuses json_schema is a warning, not a failure: the gateway then sends
json_object with the schema in the system message. Costs a few cents.

make.name: lint
make.recipe:
ruff check .
ruff format --check .
python scripts/reqtrace.py --check

make.name: trace
make.comment: Regenerate docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (PRD rows and invariants -> code and tests) after changing PRD rows or test markers.

make.name: reference
make.comment: Three pinned workloads (tickets, mixed, research) must still reproduce v0.4.0's behaviour (about 25 s; CI runs it).

make.name: web
make.comment: React app (web/) -> ratchet/web/dist, which the gateway serves at /, /scout and /dashboard.
make.recipe: cd web && npm ci && npm run build

make.name: web-dev
make.comment: Hot-reload UI on :5173 against a gateway on :8000 (run `make demo` in another terminal).
make.recipe: cd web && npm ci && npm run dev

make.name: clean
make.recipe:
rm -rf .pytest_cache .ruff_cache .coverage build dist *.egg-info sim_results.json ratchet.db
find . -name __pycache__ -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
